parameters.name: IsSuperAdmin
parameters.rationale: User struct boolean field. Checked in comments.go:89 and topics.go:103 for sticky/readonly override. Also used in admin.go for admin page access.

parameters.name: IsSuperMod
parameters.rationale: User struct boolean field. Same authorization role as IsSuperAdmin for sticky/readonly privileges.

parameters.name: modUser.DomainID
parameters.rationale: Compared with the active domain before moderator deletion; a mismatch is rejected with HTTP 403.

parameters.name: topic.IsReadOnly
parameters.rationale: Prevents comment submission to a read-only topic and enforces the decision with HTTP 403.

parameters.name: domain.IsRegularSigninEnabled
parameters.rationale: Controls whether password-based sign-in is permitted for the domain; disabled sign-in is rejected with HTTP 403.

parameters.name: signupToken
parameters.rationale: Acts as a registration capability token and is checked in terminating HTTP 403 signup guards.

parameters.name: user
parameters.rationale: Represents the current authenticated principal; a nil value blocks profile modification with HTTP 403.
